rijschool: Jve Rijopleidingen B.V. t.h.o.d.n. ANWB Rijopleiding
english_evidence: Multiple English-language learner reviews on the Google/rijloket profile, e.g. 'So far I had a profles and first 2 hours driving lesson with ANWB driving school in Den Bosch ... my instructor ... explains things well and very helpful' and 'I really like ANWB. They offer excellent driving courses with professional instructors'. ANWB national site also offers 'Information in English'.
price_signal: Proefles (trial lesson) costs €45, free if you continue lessons; package deals advertised (no per-hour rate published)
notes: ANWB Rijopleiding franchise; the operating legal entity is Jve Rijopleidingen B.V. (KvK 68525648; rijschoolspecialist lists vestigingsnummer 685256480000). CONFLICTING FOUNDING SIGNALS: rijloket states this specific local school is 'Actief sinds 2008 / Sinds 2008', while the national ANWB Rijopleiding brand (Den Haag, the franchisor) was 'opgericht in 1997'. Used 2008 as it reflects this local entity. Offers faalangst (test-anxiety) training and theory lessons. Large school: ~165-288 B exams/year (264 CBR exams last 12 months per source data). Mostly schakel/manual (123 exams) with automaat available (19 exams). Above-average pass rate (~60.6% B, +11.9% vs national). Examenlocatie: Den Bosch.
